name: Absorption-only model
definition: A participating medium model where particles absorb all intercepted light and do not scatter or emit. Assumes identical spherical particles of radius r and projected area A = πr², with number density ρ.
summary: The absorption-only model simulates light attenuation through a medium that absorbs all intercepted light without scattering, distinguishing itself by assuming zero scattering and surfaces that only emit light.
